WhatsApp introduces usernames, sparking privacy and misuse concerns

WhatsApp is rolling out a new feature allowing users to create usernames, enabling communication without sharing phone numbers. While intended to enhance privacy, the change has raised concerns about potential misuse for impersonation and scams. The Indian government is reportedly reviewing the feature due to these fears.
